value.rationale: This isolates a natural next exponent pattern in an existing equality problem and rules out solutions at every squared-support size, not just in one more enumerated layer. The interaction between the prime cofactor inequality, quadratic-residue obstruction and 2-adic comparison gives a structural explanation; the already known positive examples are not the contribution. It makes no claim about composite cofactors, higher exponents or infinitude of general solutions.
